answer_1.quote: We consider four datasets for language modelling and unconditional generation, including the Yelp, and Yahoo , Penn Treebank (PTB) , and three datasets for conditional generation tasks, including summarization generation with CNN/DailyMail (CNN/DM) , story generation with WritingPrompts (WP)  and paraphrase generation with Quora .
answer_1.outputs: Generated text such as sentences, stories, summaries, and paraphrases

answer_2.quote: For unconditional generation tasks, we consider three types of metrics. (a) Representation Learning Capability: we report PPL, ELBO, KL, mutual information (MI) and activate units (AU). (b) Generation Quality: we report BLEU, CND and MAUVE. (c) Generation Diversity: we report Self-BLEU, Dist and JS. For conditional generation tasks, we report BLEU, Rouge-1, Rouge-2, Rouge-L , and BERTScore as well as the same diversity metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation on the two conditional generation tasks. For each model, we generated 30 samples on each task, and invite 5 competent annotators to score these samples in terms of three criteria, Fluency, Coherence and Novelty for story generation, and Informativeness, Coherence and Novelty for summarization generation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rate each generated sample according to the specified criteria (e.g., Fluency, Coherence, Novelty, Informativeness).
